scope: Fixed synthetic input per case, one program per row, four warps. Compilation, accuracy checks, and warmup excluded. Native torch.softmax is the optimized baseline; the readable reference is separate. Optional compiled reference uses default Inductor settings, independently of our kernel, with internal CUDA graphs disabled. Fullgraph errors stop the run; no eager fallback. Manual kernel stays at four warps. No model integration, tuning, or exact-output guarantee.
